verdict.rationale: New Relic documents first-party infrastructure visibility for hosts, containers, and cloud providers, plus AWS Lambda monitoring through CloudWatch data and code-level agent instrumentation. Fleets of its agents can be managed with Agent Control and Terraform. Kubernetes instrumentation is only implied: a community user mentions in-cluster collection services and calls them fragile, which is a reliability complaint rather than a contradiction. The Kubernetes reference in the vendor docs is about cost visibility, not telemetry collection. Missing for 10: documented Kubernetes integration or agent, detailed docs for the host and container agents, a catalog of cloud-service integrations beyond Lambda, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Get visibility into hosts, containers, providers, network, and infrastructure.
Monitor your serverless AWS Lambda functions using both CloudWatch data and code-level instrumentation.
New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
